meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让编码智能体通过 OpenCode 调用不同大模型。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建编码智能体,并希望它们通过 OpenCode 使用多家模型。
copy.tagline_en: Make your coding agents call multiple LLMs through OpenCode.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building coding agents and want them to use multiple LLMs through OpenCode.

howto.what: 运行后 NanoClaw 会加入 OpenCode 提供器：复制相关代码、安装依赖、重建镜像，使每个智能体小组都能换成 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等外部模型，不再只默认用 Claude。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 安装或配置 OpenCode（例如要用 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 的模型）时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 装上 OpenCode，用 DeepSeek 模型
say.note: 它会复制文件、装依赖并重建镜像

say.text: 我想用 OpenCode Zen，模型设为 big-pickle
say.note: 会按 x-api-key 方式注册密钥

howto.what_en: Installs the OpenCode provider into NanoClaw: copies source files, appends barrel registrations, pins dependencies, rebuilds the image, and updates existing per-group overlays. OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Anthropic, etc. can then be used per agent group.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user asks to add or configure OpenCode as the agent provider, e.g. to use OpenRouter, DeepSeek, or OpenCode Zen models.

say_en.text: Install OpenCode support in NanoClaw and use DeepSeek models.
say_en.note: Copies files, installs deps, rebuilds image.

say_en.text: Configure OpenCode so my agents use OpenRouter claude-sonnet-4.
say_en.note: Updates the group config and restarts it.

say_en.text: Set up OpenCode Zen with model big-pickle for me.
say_en.note: Registers the key using x-api-key header.
